meta.parties: Vander Poorten v. The Commissioner of Income Tax

rules.statement: A legacy paid under the last will of a deceased person does not form part of the statutory income of a beneficiary within the meaning of section 11(11) of the Income Tax Ordinance and is not liable to tax in the hands of the legatee.
rules.supporting_quote: "This sum cannot be caught up under section 11 (11) far two reasons: (1) It is 'a capital sum. (2) The wife of the assessee, i.e. the person receiving the legacy, is not a beneficiary of the estate of a deceased person."
